---
title: "Serials"
subtitle: "Every serial issued under 1.3.6.1.4.1.66606"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# THE PAGE READS THE REGISTERS AT RENDER TIME. IT STORES NOTHING.
#
# It used to be generated out of band and committed, which put the identifiers
# in two places: the registers authored them and this file repeated them. The
# repetition needed a gate to catch the drift, and the gate went red every time
# a site allocated a serial. Nothing here can drift now, because nothing here
# is a copy.
#
# Each site keeps its own SERIALS.usda. `pen-66606.usda` names the sites and
# composes them for a workspace checkout; this page cannot compose across
# repositories, so it reads that layer for the site table and then fetches each
# site's register from its own repository.
#
# A fetch that fails RAISES. A page that rendered without a site would look
# exactly like a site with no serials, and the reader would have no way to tell
# the difference.

import urllib.request
from pxr import Sdf, Usd

RAW = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{repo}/main/{path}"
# The one piece of coupling: where the site table lives. Everything else on
# this page is read out of it.
COMPOSED = RAW.format(owner="weftspun", repo="request-for-discussion",
                      path="pen-66606.usda")


def fetch(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as r:
        if r.status != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{url} answered {r.status}")
        return r.read().decode("utf-8")


def layer(text, url):
    lyr = Sdf.Layer.CreateAnonymous(".usda")
    if not lyr.ImportFromString(text):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{url} does not parse as USD")
    return lyr


def relations(lyr):
    """(path, {column: values}) for every relation a layer authors."""
    found = []

    def walk(spec):
        cols = spec.attributes.get("columns")
        if cols is not None and cols.default is not None:
            names = [str(c).split()[0] for c in cols.default if str(c).strip()]
            arrays = {}
            for name in names:
                a = spec.attributes.get(name)
                arrays[name] = list(a.default) if a is not None and a.default is not None else []
            found.append((str(spec.path), arrays))
        for child in spec.nameChildren:
            walk(child)

    for prim in lyr.rootPrims:
        walk(prim)
    return found


composed = layer(fetch(COMPOSED), COMPOSED)
meta = composed.customLayerData
pen = meta.get("pen", "")
holder = meta.get("holder", "")

sites = []
for row in meta.get("sites", []):
    parts = str(row).split()
    if len(parts) == 4:
        sites.append(parts)

excused = {}
for row in meta.get("sitesWithoutRegister", []):
    parts = str(row).split(None, 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        excused[parts[0]] = parts[1]

out = []
out.append("::: {.callout-note}")
out.append(f"PEN {pen.rsplit('.', 1)[-1]} is registered to {holder}. RFC 9371 gives the")
out.append("registration procedure, and the assignment is itself the delegation, so no arc")
out.append(f"below `{pen}` is registered with anybody.")
out.append(":::")
out.append("")
out.append("Each site authors its own serials and no other site's. This page reads every")
out.append("register as published and stores none of them, so it cannot disagree with the")
out.append("record it comes from.")
out.append("")
out.append("A serial is allocated once. It is never removed and never reused, because it is")
out.append("the last arc of an OID and an arc names one document for as long as it exists.")
out.append("")

for digit, owner, repo, arc in sites:
    out.append(f"## Site {digit}: {owner}")
    out.append("")
    out.append(f"`{repo}`, allocating under `{arc}`.")
    out.append("")
    if digit in excused:
        out.append(f"No register: {excused[digit]}.")
        out.append("")
        continue

    url = RAW.format(owner=owner, repo=repo, path="SERIALS.usda")
    tables = {}
    for path, arrays in relations(layer(fetch(url), url)):
        names = path.strip("/").split("/")
        kind = "allocated" if "Allocated" in names else "deleted" if "Deleted" in names else None
        if kind and arrays.get("serial"):
            tables.setdefault(kind, []).append(arrays)

    for arrays in tables.get("allocated", []):
        serials, slugs = arrays["serial"], arrays.get("slug", [])
        out.append(f"{len(serials)} allocated.")
        out.append("")
        out.append("| identifier | serial | slug |")
        out.append("| ---------- | ------ | ---- |")
        for serial, slug in zip(serials, slugs):
            out.append(f"| `urn:oid:{arc}.{serial}` | {serial} | {slug} |")
        out.append("")

    for arrays in tables.get("deleted", []):
        serials, where = arrays["serial"], arrays.get("recorded_in", [])
        out.append(f"{len(serials)} deleted. A deleted serial keeps its row, because")
        out.append("deleting a document does not delete a citation to it.")
        out.append("")
        out.append("| identifier | serial | deletion recorded in |")
        out.append("| ---------- | ------ | -------------------- |")
        for serial, rec in zip(serials, where):
            out.append(f"| `urn:oid:{arc}.{serial}` | {serial} | RFD {rec} |")
        out.append("")

print("\n".join(out))
```
